name: weekday_offset
description: Compute the weekday a given number of days after a named weekday; matched control verbalizes the offset number.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
days='Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday'.split();nums='zero one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen'.split()
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(112):
 d=i%7;n=random.randint(1,14)
 ctx=f'Today is {days[d]}. Advance by {n} days.'
 items.append({'prompt':ctx+' What weekday is it then? Answer:', 'answer':' '+days[(d+n)%7]})
 control.append({'prompt':ctx+' Write the number of days advanced as an English word. Answer:', 'answer':' '+nums[n]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
